title: The Work of Mothers and Caregivers
short_teaser: Mother’s Day can honor biological mothers, adoptive mothers, grandmothers, mentors, and others whose care shaped a life.
story: Mother’s Day can honor biological mothers, adoptive mothers, grandmothers, mentors, and others whose care shaped a life. Care is often remembered most clearly through repeated ordinary acts. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
